stops.title: Program dɛn
stops.caption: Ɛvanjelizm, wit de ɛn ples.
stops.speech: Awtrich program dɛn na di ɛvanjelizm ivɛnt dɛn: usay, we tɛm, ɛn wetin wɔka dɛn de go awt.

stops.title: Kach wan Sol
stops.caption: Nem ɛn nɔmba inɔf.
stops.speech: Durin awtrich yu de kach di pipul we yu mit. Nem ɛn fon nɔmba inɔf fɔ stat; di paiplain go tek am frɔm de.
